name: PC-Diagnose
description: PowerShell-based diagnostics tool for normal Windows desktop PCs.

tools.name: PCDiagLite
tools.description: Collects a lightweight desktop PC diagnostics package with grouped local analysis and clickable Event Viewer details.

parameters.name: DaysBack
parameters.description: Event analysis range in days. 0 means all available entries.

parameters.name: PrivacyMode
parameters.description: Masks typical sensitive values before ZIP creation.

tools.name: NetzwerkDiagnose
tools.description: Creates a detailed Windows network diagnostics HTML report for LAN, DNS, routing, Wi-Fi, SMB, latency, and optional speed tests.

parameters.name: OutputPath
parameters.description: Output folder for the HTML report.

parameters.name: OpenReport
parameters.description: Open the HTML report after completion.

tools.name: HDMI- und Display-Diagnose
tools.description: Analyzes active displays, EDID, HDR, display bandwidth, HDMI audio, GPU events, reconnects, and read-only state comparisons.

parameters.name: OutputRoot
parameters.description: Output folder for reports, snapshots, EDID data, and live-monitor logs.

tools.name: Hardware-Stabilitätstest
tools.description: Verification-first hardware stability testing: known data/computation is processed by CPU, RAM, GPU, VRAM, and storage, then read back and compared against the expected result. High load/temperature are permitted side effects of individual tests, not the test result itself.

parameters.name: Profile
parameters.description: Quick, Standard, or Extended - controls pass counts, data volume, and coverage.

parameters.name: OutputRoot
parameters.description: Output folder for the result package.

parameters.name: NoDownload
parameters.description: Never download third-party tools; missing tools degrade their stage to SKIPPED/UNSUPPORTED.

parameters.name: SkipTelemetry
parameters.description: Disables LibreHardwareMonitor-based telemetry sampling and the thermal guard's live sensor checks.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Shows the planned inventory, stages, and tools without starting any active hardware load.

parameters.name: SurfaceScanMaxBytes
parameters.description: Bounds the read-only Storage Surface Read scan. 0 means the full drive.
